pubmed.query: ("Dimethyl Sulfoxide"[MeSH] OR DMSO[tiab] OR "dimethyl sulfoxide"[tiab] OR dimethylsulfoxide[tiab] OR "dimethyl sulphoxide"[tiab]) AND (Randomized Controlled Trial[pt])

dmso_based_combinations.35217280: 30% ascorbic acid in 95% DMSO vs imiquimod, basal cell carcinoma (25 people, 29 lesions)
dmso_based_combinations.39085322: phytoterpenes in DMSO vs placebo, plantar fasciitis

pubmed.other_records_note: The rest use DMSO as a cryoprotectant, solvent, vehicle or dental primer; test MSM (methylsulfonylmethane, a different compound); are animal or lab studies; or are secondary/duplicate reports (e.g. PMID 12515575 cost analysis, 16013288 duplicate of 17553503, 23485788 HBO after DMSO).
